name: git-workflow
description: PR and issue workflow toolkit with a wizard desk: a detached local server prepares in background only the analyses that are new or changed and sorts every row into its step — approvable, to reject, doubtful, yours to merge, fix or decide, issues to close or hand over — shown in a pane beside the chat (a Claude Code mod in this plugin) or in the browser. Every click runs in the attached chat with its command echoed; public actions only there.
